material_units.source_text: A stochastic model needs a transition distribution $P(\cdot\mid s,a)$: the next state is sampled from $P(\cdot\mid s_t,a_t)$. If the policy is stochastic too, the action is sampled from $\pi(\cdot\mid s_t)$. A safety probability must specify whether it averages over transitions, actions, initial states, learned data, or several of these.
